jobs.brief: New jobEverybody Waves EEveryone · The first Riverside Flats Street FestivalMain St, Riverside Flats Jen: "Honey. There are eleven people in our kitchen. Earl brought a bus schedule. Benny brought a cooler. Hank brought two hundred zip-ties and says not to tell his wife."Dee: "The first Riverside street festival is today. Everybody's coming. And I do mean everybody. Even the ones who used to stand outside the laundromat."Gary: "The Wholesaler wants it to fail. Smoke bombs, our stage truck, a crew in the crowd. So: a plan. Posts for everyone. Then we stop him, without ruining a single funnel cake."
